name: Transfer funds between two of a member's own accounts
description:
Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Transfer Funds'. The From Account and To Account fields are dropdowns whose options are account numbers; select exactly the given from_account and to_account values by their account number, not by guessing a product name. Fill in the amount and post the transfer. Read back the confirmation reference after posting. This action is irreversible once posted.

Returns: confirmation_ref — Confirmation reference shown after posting.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, insufficient_funds, validation_rejected.
